blend-it: Put the sounds together. What word is it?
clap-it: Tap the drum for each part of the word.
read-sentence: Read the sentence. Tap a word if you need help.
story-read: Now you read it with me.
story-order: Put the story in order. What happened first?
trace-it: Trace the word with your finger.
spell-it: Build the word with the letters.
tricky: Listen carefully. Which word did you hear?
heart-word: This is a heart word. We learn it by heart.
grown-up: Grown-up, did they read it right?
howto-rhyme: Rhyme time! I will say a word. Then I will say three more words. Tap the one that sounds the same at the end, like cat and hat.
howto-blend: Robot talk! The robot says a word in little sounds. Put the sounds together and say the whole word.
howto-syllables: Drum time! Listen to the word. Tap the drum one time for each part. Ba, na, na is three taps.
howto-sound-it-out: Sound it out! Tap each letter to hear its sound. Then read the whole word.
howto-review: Word review! Read each word out loud. If you need help, tap Help to hear the sounds.
howto-new-word: New words! First, listen to the word. Then say it. When you read it correctly, tap Continue!
howto-challenge: Challenge word! Look at its parts and listen. Then say the word. When you read it correctly, tap Continue!
howto-sentence: Read a sentence! First listen word by word, then all at once. Then you read each yellow word, and then the whole sentence.
howto-story: Story time! First, listen to the whole story and follow the yellow word. Then we go sentence by sentence: listen, then you read each yellow word, then the whole sentence. Then three questions.
howto-trace: Trace the word! Use your finger to go over the gray letters. Then tap Done.
howto-free: Write it! Look at the word. It will hide. Write it from memory, then tap Done.
howto-tiles: Build the word! Listen to the word. Tap the letters in the right order. Then tap Check.
howto-tricky: Tricky sounds! Two words sound almost the same. Listen carefully and tap the word you heard.
howto-segment: Sound boxes! Listen to the word. Say each sound and tap one box for each sound. Cat has three sounds: c, a, t.
howto-fluency: One-minute read! When your grown-up taps Start, read the story out loud. Read your best, not your fastest.
howto-retell: Tell me the story! Tell what happened at the beginning, in the middle, and at the end.
segment-say: Say each sound and tap a box for each one.
tap-mic: Your turn! Tap the microphone, then read out loud. Or tap the ear to listen and repeat.
repeat-word: Listen, then say it yourself. When you finish, tap the green arrow.
repeat-sentence: Listen, then read it yourself. When you finish, tap the green arrow.
read-sentence-now: Your turn! Tap the microphone and read the sentence.
choose-answer: Listen to each answer. Then tap your choice.
retell-done: Tell it in your own words. When you finish, tap the green arrow.
lets-go: Tap the green arrow to start.
finished-independent: Great practice! You are done for today. Tap the green button to go home.
howto-sentence-independent: Listen to the sentence and follow the yellow word. Then it is your turn to read. You can always listen and repeat.
howto-story-independent: Listen to the story and follow the yellow words. Then read with me, answer questions, and tell the story.
howto-story-simple: Story time! Read one sentence out loud, then tap Continue. Tap the speaker if you want to hear it. You can skip a part whenever you want.
